message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"e021","prompts":["帮我把 USGS 上某个站点最近一周的 streamflow 数据拉下来，site number 是 01646500，要 daily mean discharge，最后存成 csv。","我在做河流水位分析，需要用 Python 把 station 01428750 过去一个月的 gage height 时间序列 download 下来，能帮我写个脚本吗？","老板要密西西比河某段的历史流量数据，我记得 USGS NWIS 上能查，你帮我把 2000 到 2010 年的 annual statistics 拿下来吧。","我想对比上游和下游两个 gauge 的实时水位，site IDs 分别是 09380000 和 09382000，帮我把最近 24 小时的 data 拉出来看看。","同事给了我一串 USGS 的 site number，我要批量检查哪些站点有 instantaneous discharge 数据可用，可以写个循环去 query 一下吗？"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e022","prompts":["I have a Word template for offer letters that uses {{candidate_name}} and {{start_date}} placeholders, but some of them are split across runs inside table cells. Can you write a script that fills them reliably and saves the result as a new file?","Every page of our generated .docx report needs the company logo in the header and a page number footer. How do I add those programmatically after the document is already built?","My contract document has a table nested inside another table, and when I try to append a row to the inner table with python-docx it either crashes or adds it to the wrong table. How can I target the nested table correctly?","I need to insert a signature block into an existing Word doc only after the phrase \"Approved by:\" — the phrase might be inside a header, footer, or the body. Can you write code that covers all three locations?","Please write a script that walks through a .docx file, finds all the <<PLACEHOLDER>> style tokens including ones broken across multiple runs, lists them, and replaces each one with values from a JSON mapping."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e023","prompts":["我有一个排班问题需要建成整数规划：5 个员工、14 天，每人每天最多一班，还有最少休息天数约束，请帮我选一个本机已装的求解器解出来，并输出求解状态和目标值。","帮我写一个选址模型的 MIP，30 个候选点里选 8 个，要求覆盖所有需求点，求解后把 objective 和 bound 一起报告出来，方便我判断 gap。","上一轮求解的结果我不确定是不是可行解，帮我从输出文件里把 schedule 提取出来，重新算一遍总成本，核对和 solver 报告的 objective value 是否一致。","这篇优化报告里要求写清楚 formulation、求解器状态、最优目标和 integrality gap，请按这个结构帮我整理一份一致的报告，数据用 benchmark 目录下的输出文件。","我需要对比 CBC 和 Gurobi 在同一个背包问题实例上的表现，请保留每个 solver 的求解证书和日志，最后汇总成一张运行时间和 gap 的对比表。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e024","prompts":["那个修复内存泄漏的 pull request 已经合并进 main 了，帮我把它 close 掉，PR 编号是 #482。","我重新想了一下，#1337 这个 PR 的方案不对，先帮我 close，之后我会重新提一个。","merge 完之后忘记关 PR 了，麻烦把仓库里的 #920 设成 closed 状态。","刚才误关了 #205，帮我把它的 state 改回 open。","团队决定放弃这个 feature 了，请把对应仓库里那个还开着的 pull request 关闭，编号是 #1670。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e025","prompts":["I recorded a tutorial where I paused a lot between steps. I have a list of the quiet segments with start and end timestamps — how do I cut all of them out and stitch the rest back together losslessly?","I have 20 lecture videos that each have the same 12-second intro and outro. Can you write a script that removes those segments from every file in a folder and produces the trimmed versions?","My interview recording has dead air and throat-clearing at 3:12-3:45, 17:08-17:30, and 42:01-42:15. Please give me the ffmpeg command to remove those three chunks and keep everything else in order.","I detected the boring parts of my gaming stream and exported their timestamps to a text file. Now I want to build a highlight reel from the remaining footage — how should I chain that in ffmpeg?","How can I remove several segments from a video in one pass with ffmpeg so I don't lose quality from re-encoding the file multiple times?"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e026","prompts":["帮我把这份调研笔记整理成一份正式的 Word 报告，要有封面、目录和页码，标题层级分清楚。","我需要生成一批入职通知的 .docx，每个人的姓名、部门和入职日期不同，能写个脚本套模板批量生成吗？","这个 Word 文档里有很多批注和修订痕迹，帮我把它们全部清理掉，只保留干净的正文。","请把 attachments 文件夹里的几个 docx 合并成一份文档，图片和表格都要保留，并重新排一下标题编号。","我要给客户写一份项目交付说明的 Word 文档，页眉放公司名称，首页要有 logo 图片，正文里还要插入几张截图，怎么做？"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e027","prompts":["这个重构计划的大 issue 拆出来几个子任务，麻烦把它们作为 sub-issue 挂到父 issue 下面，父 issue 编号是 #301。","我想把新发现的三个小 bug 分别记录成 issue，然后都关联到 epic #88 里面，帮我建好 sub-issue。","#512 这个架构改造的父 issue 下面还差两个实施步骤没挂，帮我补上，标题我发给你。","帮我在我们仓库的 #204 下面添加一个 sub-issue，专门跟进数据库 migration 的部分。","之前建的那几个任务 issue 是独立的，现在想把它们全部变成 #77 这个 parent issue 的 sub-issue，帮我逐个加上。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e028","prompts":["I've broken the migration epic into four concrete tasks. Can you attach each one as a sub-issue under the parent issue so they show up in the tracker?","Please add a sub-issue to #482 for tracking the API changes separately from the UI work — title it \"Refactor endpoint payloads\".","We're planning the release in #90. Add three sub-issues to it: docs update, QA pass, and changelog generation.","I accidentally created the packaging task as a standalone issue instead of linking it. Can you add it as a sub-issue to the build pipeline parent?","Before the sprint planning meeting, I need the auth refactor parent issue to have sub-issues for the login flow, token refresh, and session expiry work."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e029","prompts":["我下周去成都出差，想找几家本地人常去的川菜馆，帮我查查有什么推荐的。","朋友来杭州玩两天，帮我推荐几家西湖附近适合请客的餐厅，最好环境好一点。","帮我确认一下西安有没有评分比较高的日料店，周六晚上打算带家人去吃。","我们在讨论团建去哪儿吃饭，深圳福田区有什么适合十个人的包间餐厅吗？","下周去北京出差，想尝尝正宗的烤鸭，帮我找几家值得去的店。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e030","prompts":["刚才手滑在 review comment 上点了个 👍，帮我把这个 reaction 撤掉，comment 在 PR #665 里。","有人在 code review 的评论下帮我加了个 confused 表情，但那是我误加的，麻烦帮我 remove 掉。","我在好几条 review comment 上都加了 emoji reaction，现在想统一清理，帮我移除 #312 这个 PR 下面某条评论的 🎉。","帮我把之前在 pull request review 里那条关于 logging 的 comment 上的 heart reaction 删掉，我改主意了。","团队规定不要在 review comment 上放表情，我昨天违规加了几个，请帮我把 #908 里那条 comment 的 reaction 去掉。"],"rubric":[]}]}
